description: Research Experiences for Undergraduates (REU), NSF NHERI 2024: Temperature Gradient Change during Permafrost Thawing in a Centrifuge is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Hamad Khan, University of California Davis (ucdavis.edu). This research project focuses on the thermal gradient change of permafrost using a centrifuge. As climate change is becoming more of an issue, permafrost is thawing, so this project looks at the thawing rate and depth in a scaled-up model. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project with 3 top-level files (PDF). Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-nds5-y560. Keywords: NSF NHERI UC Davis CGM, Permafrost Thawing, Global Warming, Thermal Gradient Change. Published 2024-08-23. Facility named: Center for Geotechnical Modeling - University of California, Davis. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0 (labelled "Creative Commons Attribution" on the DesignSafe project). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
